name: Windtalker (Teamwork)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Linguistics 1 rank

Benefit(s): You gain access to the windtalk secret language.

Windtalk is spoken differently for each person. Only an ally who also has this feat can understand the windtalk of another character. If the character with this feat has at least 5 ranks in Linguistics, windtalk defies comprehend languages and similar spells or abilities such as tongue of the sun and moon.
